name: Snow White and Rose Red
source:
Join Snow White and her sister, Feathersoft, in a magical winter fairy-tale land! As they search for the rare alpine rose, they meet a mysterious bear who becomes their friend. Will their journey be filled with challenging hardships, or will they discover their true happily ever after? Find out in this cute yuri retelling of the classic Grimm Brothers fairy-tale! Snow White and Rose Red! 

[From [url=https://alternativewonders.itch.io/snow-white-and-rose-red]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与白雪公主和她的妹妹Feathersoft一起进入神奇的冬季童话世界！当他们寻找稀有的高山玫瑰时，他们遇到了一只神秘的熊，并成为了他们的朋友。他们的旅程会充满挑战，还是会找到真正的幸福？在这个可爱的尤里重述经典格林兄弟童话故事中找到答案！雪白和玫红！

[来自[url=https://alternativewonders.itch.io/snow-white-and-rose-red]itch.io[/url]]
